title: Photo: woman on a kneeling camel, Mount of Olives, Jerusalem (2013)
summary: A photograph of a smiling woman in a wide-brimmed hat sitting on a camel that is kneeling on a stone terrace on the Mount of Olives, with Jerusalem and the golden Dome of the Rock behind. Caption: Mount of Olives, Jerusalem, Israel, 2013.

pictures.description: Colour photo on a sunny day: a smiling woman in a wide-brimmed hat, pink-sleeved top and white trousers sits on a white camel with a red patterned saddle blanket; the camel is kneeling on a paved stone terrace. A man in a cap and blue T-shirt holds the camel's rope. Tourists stand at an iron railing, one with a blue umbrella. Behind them the Old City of Jerusalem spreads out under a pale blue sky, with the golden Dome of the Rock, the city wall and a hillside cemetery.
